surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the plasma-assisted atomic layer deposition (PEALD) of NiO using nickelocene (Ni(Cp)2) as a precursor and O2 plasma as a co-reagent. The process utilizes a sequence of precursor pulse and plasma ignition steps to facilitate surface reactions. The plasma provides the necessary oxidizing environment for the deposition of NiO, allowing for the formation of a p-type semiconductor with controlled stoichiometry and minimal carbon contamination.
